## Implementation Notes
- Owner: `src/domains/items/**` (`definition.ts`, `taxonomy.ts`, `normalize.ts`, `validate.ts`, public `index.ts`).
- Inventory primitives (`ItemDefinitionScope`, slots, load/cost, `ItemMechanics`, …) live in `inventory-v2/primitives.ts` to avoid circular imports; `ItemDefinition` is re-exported from `inventory-v2/types.ts` + barrel.
- `normalizeItemDefinition` fills `kindKey` from `type` and `origin` from `scope`; Core catalog applies it in `listCoreItemDefinitions` / `getCoreItemDefinition` / `coreCatalogRecords`.
